question: For each subnet IP version, show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the subnet standard attribute ID, considering only subnets that have at least one route entry and excluding shared networks (i.e., networks that have an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry for `'*'` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`). Do not return any rounded answers.

       AVG(s.standard_attr_id) AS avg_std,
       VARIANCE(s.standard_attr_id) AS var_std,
       STDDEV(s.standard_attr_id) AS std_std
FROM subnets s
WHERE s.id IN (SELECT subnet_id FROM subnetroutes)
  AND s.network_id NOT IN (
      SELECT object_id FROM networkrbacs
      WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'
        AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
  )
GROUP BY s.ip_version;

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE
